---
title: "Record the haircut and finish the groom"
subtitle: "SOP GRM-13 · Groomer manual"
---

## Purpose

Record what was done on the visit (services, coat, style and any changes from
the dog's usual) and finish the groom, so the next groomer starts from it.

## Applies to

Every groomer, at the end of every groom.

## Before you begin

- The groom was started with **Start groom**. See [GRM-02 Check in a
  dog](checking-in-a-dog.qmd).
- The dog's card shows **Being groomed**.

## Procedure

1. Click **Record the haircut** on the dog's card. The **Record the haircut**
   form opens. At the top, it shows the dog's **Usual style** and what was
   done **Last time**.

   To go back to the dog's card without saving, click **Back to** the dog's
   name at the top right. The groom stays open.

   ![The Record the haircut form](/screenshots/groomer/haircut.png)

### What was done

2. Under **What was done**, click each service done on this visit, for
   example **Bath**, **Nail trim** and **Full groom**. A ticked service shows
   **✓**. Only **Full groom** records a haircut.

### The coat

3. Under **Condition**, click the number that matches the coat, from **1**
   to **5**.
4. Under **Thickness**, click the coat's thickness.

### The haircut

This part appears only when **Full groom** is ticked. It starts from the
dog's usual style.

5. Under **Style**, click the style done today. Under **Length**, click the
   length.
6. Under **Zone by zone**, change only the parts of the dog you did
   differently from the style, by choosing a different cut for that zone. To
   put a zone back, click **Undo** beside it.
7. If the haircut is different from the dog's usual, the form asks **Why is
   it different from** the dog's **usual today?** Click a reason, for example
   **Owner asked** or **Coat condition**, or type one.
8. To make today's haircut the dog's usual style from now on, tick **Make
   this** the dog's **usual style from now on**. The next groom starts from
   it.

### Finish

9. Click **Notes for next time** and type how it went and anything the next
   groomer should know.
10. Click **Save and finish the groom**.

## Result

The groom is finished. The dog's card no longer shows **Being groomed**, and
**Last visit** shows today's haircut.

## If something goes wrong

### To finish: …

**Save and finish the groom** cannot be clicked. The words after **To
finish:** list what is still missing. Fill in each one.

### Matted all over: a #7F shave-down.

You chose **Shave-down** for a matted coat. Tell the owner it will be short,
and why.

### Pelted: shaved close with a #10.

The coat is at the worst condition. Tell the owner the shave can leave the
skin red, itchy or nicked, and that the coat takes months to grow back. Then
tick the box to confirm you have told them. The groom cannot be finished
without it.

### A coat at level … doesn't call for a shave-down.

A shave-down on a coat in this condition needs a manager's OK. Ask a manager.
Click **Reason** and type why, then under **OK'd by** click the manager who
agreed.

### … is under the shop's grooming age.

The dog is a puppy under the shop's minimum age for a haircut. A haircut needs
a manager's OK. Click **Reason** and type why, then under **OK'd by** click
the manager who agreed.
